# Main

## Adrià Mitjavila Ventura {#title}

### Bioinformatician | LaCaixa INPhINIT Fellow | PhD student at *Institut Josep Carreras* | MSc

Bioinformatician with training in Molecular Genetics and Biotechnology, and more than 5 years of experience working in well known research centers in Spain and Italy.

With a solid background in Genomics and Transcriptomics, I aim to analyse large NGS data sets and develop analysis workflows to solve complex biological problems in the context of evolution, gene regulation and cancer.

Innovative and agile thinker always striving to face a challenge and find the right solution. I enjoy working independently as well as in a collaborative environment to deliver the best results. With experience in mentoring and support students, and in scientific training and outreach activities.

I look forward to joining an international team in the healthcare sector where I can make the most of my skills and to grow in a stimulating work environment.
